verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.baseten.co (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of doc pages whose headers point agents to the full documentation index. First-party docs also provide an agent-setup page with a skill and MCP servers that let coding agents search the docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
